race.comment: SCULLY (1) is the one to beat despite an awkward draw and top weight, with his latest fifth in BM66+ Saturday company at Ascot reading well enough for this easier assignment. He is proven at this track and distance and Chris Parnham going back aboard adds to the case. SATURDAY SESH (3) has been plain at his past two, but he was respected in betting when fading late at Ascot. Steve Parnham replaces the apprentice hoop and he can bounce back to form coming back to the midweeks. STRIDEAWAY (4) is the sharp improver after racing wide throughout at Ascot, and her previous third at this venue had merit after she struck traffic in the straight. First-time blinkers add interest. DREAMERS NEVER DIE (8) has been rather plain in his past couple, but the rise in trip is a big tick, as is the booking of Fiore. Drawn the inside and can improve quickly. LIEUTENANT DUNBAR (10) has to be included on recent form.
